For purchase value up to Rs. 2.00 lakh. 2. Export/Deemed Export by the supplier. 3. Sale of goods or services such as original equipment prices lower than the price charged fo r normal replacement. 4. Sale of goods such as drugs, which have expiry date.

5. Sales of goods or services at lower prices, a) on or after the date of completion of sale/placement of order of goods or services by the authority concerned, under the existing or previous Rate Contracts. b) Under any previous contracts entered with the Central or State Government Departments , including new undertakings (excluding joint sector companies and or private parties) and b odies. 5. " 6. Security Deposit (Performance Security in GeM): The successful bidder shall submit a Security deposit of five (5) % of the total landed value, incl uding all taxes, duties, and other costs and charges within 30 days from the date of the award of the contract. The Bid security (EMD) amount and payments will be released from the buyer o nly after submission of the SD (if applicable). The submitted security deposit may be conv erted into PBG wherever PBG is required, at the option of the supplier. Submission of a security deposit is exempt in the following Cases: 1. The contracts have a value of up to Rs. 05 Lakh. 2. All Central/State Government Organization/PSU, Govt. Ministries, Departments, Attached and Subordinate Offices, Autonomous bodies formed by the government will be exempt from the submission of SD, and OEM/OES will be exempt in case of procurement of spar e parts for equipment. The submission of the Security deposit will be waived if the supplier completes the s cope of supply as per the contract within 30 days from the issue of the contract, as t he purpose of the submission of the SD is fulfilled. The security deposit shall be in the form of a Demand Draft or a Bank Guarantee as per RBI Sch eduled Bank in the purchaser’s country format (On a non-judicial stamp paper). The Security De posit shall be in the same currency in which the contract is to be signed. The submitted security deposits shall remain valid for up to 60 days after the completion of the scope of supply. And subject to an extension of the validity period required if the completion of the scope of supply is required. The submitted Security deposit will be released by the purchaser within 30 days from executio n of the scope of supply and submission of Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) (if applicable as per the contract) If the supplier fails to deposit the security deposit or does not complete the scope of supply with

in 30 days, the order may be canceled. And the buyer may purchase elsewhere at the successf ul bidder's own risk and cost. Any other penal action may be deemed fit by Coal India Limited. In cases where the successful tenderer did not submit the Security Deposit within 30 days, the SD may be deducted from invoices submitted for the subsequent completion of the scope of su pplies. And a penalty equivalent to 0.5% (half a Percentage) of the SD amount for each week or part thereof (calculated from the 31st day from the placement of the Order) till the date of recei pt of full SD/deduction of full SD. The penalty to be levied is subject to a maximum of 05% of th e contract value. The PBG may be submitted through the Structured Financial Management Sys tem (SFMS). 8.
